name: Maho☆Gaku ~Mahoroba Kokusai Bouei Daigaku Fuzoku Gakuen~
original_name: まほ☆がく～まほろば国際防衛大学付属学園～
source:
Main character graduated from Maho Gaku University, worked as UN lieutenant, and currently is a special agent for Meguin Hunters who track aliens that live assuming form of humans.
For some reason protagonist is invited as a temporary lecturer to his alma mater. There he leads a sweet, fun and naughty life with five beautiful girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
